note: Level-0 workload presets. Every field here is a PLANNING ASSUMPTION, not a measurement: the token volumes, request mixes and prompt/output shapes are typical-order figures chosen to give a first comparison something to stand on, and each preset is labelled assumed for exactly the reason lane-c-presets.json is (SPEC 6.5). No preset backs a modelled_p95_capacity verdict, and none is evidence. Selecting one fills the same inputs a user would type by hand; every number stays editable and every result still carries its own provenance.

provenance.basis: order-of-magnitude planning shapes, not customer telemetry

presets.label: Chatbot / support
presets.assumption_note: short prompts, short answers, steady daytime traffic — a typical support-desk shape, not a measured tenant

presets.label: Coding agent
presets.assumption_note: large prompts from repository context with moderate output — the shape this calculator's own F7 fixture uses

presets.label: Batch / bulk
presets.assumption_note: offline enrichment or document processing; high utilization is assumed because the work can be queued, which is exactly the assumption to challenge

presets.label: Custom
presets.summary: Start from the current values and edit
presets.assumption_note: nothing is overwritten — the current values stay planning assumptions until you review and edit them
